title: Presentation of “{{title}}”
intro: Choose what your audience sees, in which order, and what only you see. The slides follow your teaching: when you change the teaching, they change too.

start.text: Make slides from this teaching: its title, passages, central message, points or steps, questions and kept images, in the teaching's order. You then keep, leave out, change or add slides.
start.noAi: Made by fixed rules on this computer. No assistant is used.

source.finding: A note from your Bible Study

editor.name: Name of this presentation
editor.bibleDefault: The one in the Scripture pane
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this presentation? The teaching stays as it is.
editor.removed: Slide removed. The teaching stays as it is.
editor.pauseHint: The audience sees an empty screen. You still see your notes.
editor.heading: Heading on the slide
editor.question: Question on the slide
editor.followsTeaching: From your teaching; it changes when the teaching changes.
editor.writeOwn: Write your own for the slide
editor.ownWording: Your own wording for this presentation.
editor.imageOffline: This image is not on this computer yet. Save a copy so you can present without the internet.
editor.manuscript: From your teaching (only you see this)
editor.notesHint: Only you see these, in the Presenter View and the speaker sheet. Never on the audience screen.

warnings.noBible: No Bible is installed yet: Scripture slides show only the reference. Add a Bible in Settings.
warnings.scriptureUnavailable: The text of this passage is not in the chosen Bible.
warnings.imageUnavailable: This image is not on this computer.
warnings.sourceMissing: This part was removed from the teaching.
warnings.longText: A lot of text for one slide: it will be set smaller.

export.title: Export the presentation

pptx.name: PowerPoint (.pptx)
pptx.hint: Opens in PowerPoint, Keynote, LibreOffice and Google Slides.

pdf.name: PDF slides
pdf.hint: One page per slide, as the audience sees it.

speaker_pdf.name: Speaker sheet (PDF for a phone)
speaker_pdf.hint: Each slide with your manuscript and notes, in large print.

markdown.name: Markdown (.md)
markdown.hint: Simple text with headings and the Scripture.

package.name: Delivery package (.json)
package.hint: Everything in one file, images included, to present later without this database.

export.includeNotes: Include my manuscript and speaker notes
export.private: The file is made on this computer and saved only where you choose. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the teaching is not changed.
export.savedMissing_one: Saved: {{path}}. {{count}} image is not on this computer and is shown as a placeholder.
export.savedMissing_other: Saved: {{path}}. {{count}} images are not on this computer and are shown as placeholders.

labels.imageUnavailable: Image not available on this computer
labels.scriptureUnavailable: The text of this passage is not available.

presenter.title: Presenter View
presenter.empty: This presentation has no slides to show yet.
presenter.keepAwakeOn: The screen stays on while you present.
presenter.keepAwakeUnavailable: This system does not let the app keep the screen on. If it turns off while you present, change the power settings.
presenter.keys: Keys: → or Page Down for the next slide, ← or Page Up to go back, B for an empty audience screen, Esc to leave.
presenter.audienceHelp: The audience sees only the slides: never your notes, manuscript or sources.
presenter.noSecondWindow: A second window cannot be opened here. Show the slides in this window instead (for a mirrored screen); Esc brings you back.
presenter.oneScreen: Only one screen is connected. Connect a projector or second screen, or show the slides in this window.
presenter.noBible: No Bible is installed to look up the passage.
